queue.title: Auto-promote degraded platforms when engagement probe detects signals
queue.description: When engagement-surface-probe detects signals above threshold (weight >= 6), automatically create a work-queue item to investigate and promote the platform from degraded to active. Currently probe only adds notes to account-registry — make it actionable.

outcome.note: Auto-creates work-queue items when probe detects engagement signals >= threshold. Platform-name dedup prevents duplicates. Prehook summary reports created items.

queue.title: Engagement probe JS bundle follow-up
queue.description: (added ~s699): Current engagement-surface-probe only scans the initial HTML response. SPAs that lazy-load JS bundles may hide API routes in chunk files. A follow-up could extract `<script src="...">` URLs from the HTML, fetch the top 2-3 JS bundles, and scan those for API patterns too. Would improve detection for React/Next.js SPAs where the HTML is just a shell.
